welcome_markdown:
Good day and welcome to poi {{version}}! Before you start, here is some information for you!

**poi will never modify your game data, but please use trusted releases and plugins!**

poi does not use a proxy by default, and you can change this in the settings panel:

- If you're using HTTP or Socks5 proxies, make sure it matches your proxy information;
- If you're using VPN, simply leave it unset;
- You may also consider enabling the Editing DMM Cookie Region Flag setting.

If poi is underperforming, you may disable some plugins.

If you prefer alphabetic names to Japanese ones, you may try the `Translator` plugin.

---

Like poi? Have suggestions? Interested in contributing? [Please see here](https://github.com/poooi/poi)
cert_error_markdown:
A certificate error occurred for the URL `{{url}}`. It may be caused by using a proxy with self-signed certificate, or under a man-in-the-middle attack.

This certificate is issued by **{{name}}** and its sha256 value is **{{value}}**.

Pressing `Trust` will allow all connections using this certificate; pressing `Ignore` will deny further connections using this certificate.

It's recommended to choose `Ignore` when the game page works correctly.

Trust this certificate only when it's issued by a trusted provider (e.g. your proxy provider).

If you're using a proxy with self-signed certificate, it's recommended to import your proxy provider's self-signed root CA.
